name: Called by the Tomb
body:
School necromancy; Level cleric/oracle 2, death mage 2, inquisitor 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, white necromancer 2
Target one undead creature

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as hold person except you manipulate negative energies powering undead creatures to target them. Mindless undead do not get a saving throw to negate this spell or end it early.
